title: Where the Checker Should Stop
objective: Apply the rule of thumb to a checker of 180 lines with 4 functions, and print the decision.
prerequisites: The Summary and the Exit Code
hint: Set $lines = 180 and $functions = 4. Then an if with $lines -gt 100 -or $functions -gt 6 as the test. Write-Output Move this checker to a .NET program in the if block, and Keep this checker in PowerShell in the else block.
